steps.text: Talk to Father Aereck in the Lumbridge church. (Lumbridge teleport can be used for quick travel to Lumbridge)
Go through the graveyard's southern exit and head to the hut west of Lumbridge Swamp.
Talk to Father Urhney inside the hut.
chat: 2. Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
1. He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.

steps.text: Head to the small room in the Lumbridge graveyard south of the church.
Equip the Ghostspeak amulet and click the coffin, talk to the ghost.
chat: 1. Yep, now tell me what the problem is.

steps.text: Head to the Wizards' Tower, and climb down the ladder to the basement. (Use Necklace of passage to teleport to Wizards' Tower if you have one.)
Search the altar, and you will receive a ghost's skull. A level 13 skeleton will appear, you don't have to kill it, just leave.
Go back to the graveyard and use the skull on the coffin with it open.
